name: carpenter's goods

product.purpose: Prepare Etsy and Shopify product drafts and track agreed commissions from owner-exported sales.
product.publication: Manual publication only after owner approval; no platform write connector is used.
product.billing: Commission per sale, with the rate agreed in writing with the carpenter.

your_steps.title: Agree the commission in writing
your_steps.when: Before preparing the launch files or tracking sales
your_steps.detail: Fill and review agreement/commission-agreement.md with the carpenter, including the eligible order amount and treatment of tax, shipping, discounts, refunds, and fees. Both people sign it themselves. Also provide maker-confirmed product facts, local photos, three current source-linked completed-sale comparisons, and owner-exported Etsy/Shopify order CSVs when available. The legacy paid-sales.json input is also supported by the CLI. Glacier does not sign the agreement or connect to either shop.

your_steps.title: Review and publish the first listing
your_steps.detail: Review the prepared Etsy and Shopify drafts, photos, facts, comparable sales and price. If correct, publish manually in the shop(s) yourself. Glacier does not create accounts or publish listings.

launch_gates: Owner agrees commission terms in writing with the carpenter.
Owner approves the first product listing before manual publication.
Any paid production or order is approved by the owner.
